name: Starfall Razorfin Reach
introDiscord: Falling fragments of starlight streak through a narrow reef reach. Razorfin slice between them at terrifying speed, turning the entire route into something between a migration path and a knife drawer.
introTwitch: Falling fragments of starlight streak through a narrow reef reach. Razorfin slice between them at terrifying speed, turning the entire route into something between a migration path and a knife drawer.

meteor-shoal.prompt: Star fragments fall across a crowded meteor shoal, leaving bright impact trails between three routes. Razorfin streak through the gaps before the light can fade.

left.message: Shizuki's Starfall remedy reads: "Catch the bottle, not the falling blade. This distinction feels obvious until both are glowing."
left.fullHpMessage: The Starfall remedy remains safely in hand. You are already at full health, so there is no need to compare it with the other glowing hazards.

right.message: A Starfall Razorfin streaks past so quickly you only see the trail. It returns slower the second time—apparently so you can properly appreciate the threat.

forward.message: A Moonkeeper cache has survived beneath a coral overhang while star fragments repeatedly strike around it. Timing your dash earns Star Candies.

razor-current.prompt: A silver current funnels through a narrow gap. Razorfin use it to accelerate to deeply unreasonable speeds while three routes cut around a stone fin.

left.message: A moon-shell coffer spins inside the current. You grab it during the half-second between Razorfin passes and recover Star Candies.

right.message: Shizuki's remedy reads: "For the wound you expected and the three you absolutely did not. I ran out of labels after that."
right.fullHpMessage: Shizuki's many-wound remedy remains unused. At full health, you can spare it another label.

forward.message: One Razorfin streaks through. Then another. The third stops directly in front of you. Somehow the stationary one is more concerning.

falling-star-cut.prompt: A glowing scar cuts through the reef where ancient star fragments still fall in slow arcs. Three routes cross beneath them while Razorfin shadows weave between the light.

left.message: A Razorfin uses a falling fragment as cover, darts behind it, then emerges from the other side directly toward you. Clever little knife-fish.

right.message: A Fae vessel landed inside an impact groove and somehow survived. Inside are Star Candies and several tiny scorch marks.

forward.message: Shizuki wedged one Berry behind a battered warning sign: "Things falling from the sky: dangerous. Things swimming sideways at thirty times reasonable speed: ALSO dangerous. Educational area."

boss-antechamber.name: Bladefin Impact Crater
boss-antechamber.prompt: The Reach ends inside a crater carved by an ancient falling star. Glowing scars ring the impact site while every fast-moving shadow abruptly abandons it.

bossPromptDiscord:
Every smaller Razorfin abandons the crater.

A streak of light circles the impact site faster and faster until it becomes a continuous glowing ring.

Then the ring breaks toward you.

Use /yes to face the Starfall Bladefin or /no to leave before it completes another orbit.
bossPromptTwitch:
Every smaller Razorfin abandons the crater.

A streak of light circles the impact site faster and faster until it becomes a continuous glowing ring.

Then the ring breaks toward you.

Use !yes to face the Starfall Bladefin or !no to leave before it completes another orbit.
bossRetreatText: You leave Bladefin Impact Crater before the glowing ring completes another orbit. The smaller Razorfin do not return until you are gone.

boss.revealText: The glowing ring snaps inward as a massive Razorfin streaks across the crater. The Starfall Bladefin strikes!

completionText: The Starfall Bladefin vanishes into the current, and the Reach slows from 'impossibly dangerous' to merely 'deeply questionable.' Another route becomes visible.
